prompt:
The image shows a ledger-style table with one Name column, several year columns in chronological order, strong horizontal rules, and minimal vertical separators. Work from the queried row and year columns to evaluate the temporal expression. For row Herm, what is the sum of the values from 2024 through 2026, inclusive?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing the ordered queried year-cell bounding boxes from the start year through the end year.
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact integer temporal result.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236],[488,180,600,236]],"answer":29}
